summary: The approved change (sac-238) is a client-only desktop packing-list page with browser-local persistence and a hosted, nonproduction review preview. The required hosted-preview path exists in context/runtime-capabilities.json: safeAdapters lists static-preview-v1, and publish_preview accepts a finished static build directory and returns an immutable run-owned Cloudflare Pages URL without agent credentials, so no local preview substitution and no block are needed. Applying the later human answers (Linear comments of 2026-09-16 15:45 and 16:08) over the earlier design text: the preview is delivered only through publish_preview/static-preview-v1 — no GitHub Actions workflow, repository Pages setup, agent provider credentials, or production release may be demonstrated or required — and no platform or infrastructure demonstration scenarios are included; internal test output stays in transcripts rather than the proof gallery. The plan is one command scenario (build, publish, anonymous reachability of the immutable URL) followed by six ordered browser scenarios captured in a single demo collection against that hosted URL at a fixed 1440x900 CSS-pixel viewport, key-trace overlay off, each scenario starting from a fresh browser context with both storage keys cleared and the empty-list state verified, and each scenario capturing its paired states before the next reset. Coverage: add with default-unpacked and literal rendering of markup-like text; rename preserving packed state with old and new names in one scenario; pack/unpack plus All and To pack views including the nothing-left-to-pack state; delete showing the item present and then absent in one scenario; persistence of names, packed states and a deletion across a real page reload shown immediately before and after; and an in-app failure-and-recovery case for whitespace-only add and rename with Escape restoring the unchanged row. Intended outcomes below are expectations, not results: the implementer records what is actually observed, and if any action in the collection fails, the cause is fixed and the whole ordered collection is recaptured from zero rather than carrying partial images into the pull request. The browser is never destroyed or reallocated inside a scenario. The app has no provider integration, so no provider-originated evidence is planned and none may be invented.
